moved.title: Moved
moved.description: True once the workflow is in the destination project; always false for a dry run.

name.title: Name
name.description: The workflow's name in the destination project.

blockers.title: Blockers
blockers.description: Why the move can't happen yet. A real move with any of these is refused with 409.

variable.title: Variable
variable.description: Name of the project variable the node setting references.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: 'removed' when the destination has no such variable, 'secret' when it is secret there and the field isn't a password field.

node_guid.title: Node Guid
node_guid.description: GUID of the node whose setting uses it.

field.title: Field
field.description: Label of the setting that uses it.

missing_variables.title: Missing Variables
missing_variables.description: Node settings whose ${project:...} references the destination's variables won't resolve. Moved anyway; the nodes refuse to start until fixed.

version.title: Version
version.description: Published version copied into the destination project.

new_library.title: New Library
new_library.description: True when the destination had no library of this name, so its working copy is created too.

libraries.title: Libraries
libraries.description: Library versions copied (or, for a dry run, to be copied) into the destination project.

uncommitted_users.title: Uncommitted Users
uncommitted_users.description: Users with uncommitted edits to this workflow in their dev clone of the source project. Those edits stay behind.

400.description: The destination is the workflow's own project

403.description: The caller doesn't collaborate on the destination project

404.description: Project, destination project or workflow not found

409.description: The move is blocked: the workflow is running or has queued messages, its name is taken in the destination, or a library version clashes
